schema.note: new review package uses frame_id/timestamp_s; upstream files keep frame/time_seconds and are mapped by the transform layer, never renamed in place

video.definition: quiet_wake = confirmed Wake but not one of the four core behaviors; NA outside Wake

calcium.rule: neural_behavior is valid only when neural_sleep_stage == W; otherwise NA

timeline.role: merge of all three sources + review_type / disagreement / reviewed + final labels

review_logic: 1. compare EEG/EMG sleep stage vs calcium sleep stage; mismatch -> sleep_stage conflict
2. only when both agree on W, compare video behavior vs calcium behavior; mismatch -> wake_behavior conflict

ma_policy.stage: MA stays a legal sleep_stage (~2.6% of frames, inherited from the reviewed baseline); it is never scripted as a conflict and is not an on-stage demo case
ma_policy.show_line: 系统支持 W / NREM / REM / MA；本次 Demo 选取稳定片段进行展示

video_ai.construction: synthetic demo stand-in; scripted few-frame errors on confusable adjacent behaviors

eeg_emg_scoring.construction: synthetic demo stand-in; acts as the sleep-stage reference, so no scripted errors

neural_decoder.construction: synthetic demo stand-in (patented decoder, fewer errors than the video AI); W<->NREM boundary offsets + rearing FN
